trait_value_raw: buzz pollinated
source_section: Abstract, p.248; Introduction, p.249; Methods, p.250
notes: Candidate trait, not in config/traits.yml — there is no dedicated buzz-pollination/sonication trait in the current vocabulary (checked 'buzz', 'sonicat', 'vibrat', 'poricidal', 'pollination_mechanism' as of 2026-08). Kept separate from the pollination_system=bee row for this taxon so it can be mapped on its own once such a trait exists (e.g. a floral pollen-release-mechanism or buzz-pollination categorical trait). Source: 'The Tetratheca species are buzz pollinated' (Abstract, p.248); 'Tetratheca has a relatively specialised pollination system (buzz pollination)' (Introduction, p.249); pollen is extracted from the anthers either by native bees sonicating and vibrating pollen loose from the anthers or by bees raking the anthers with their front legs (Methods, p.250, citing McNee 2003). See also the mapped 'flower_anther_dehiscence' = poricidal rows for the same four taxa, which capture the anther mechanism that buzz pollination acts on.
